MANU 201.title: Technical Communication
MANU 201.description: Written and oral communication in business correspondence, engineering design methods, report preparation and oral presentations of technical material. Restricted to students in second year of the Manufacturing Engineering Program. .
MANU 201.prerequisiteText: One of APSC_V 176, ENGL_V 110, ENGL_V 111, ENGL_V 112, ENGL_V 120, ENGL_V 121, WRDS_V 150

MANU 231.title: Introduction to Manufacturing Engineering
MANU 231.description: Core professional and technical skills for manufacturing engineers. Project management, teamwork, design principles, and foundational knowledge in mechanical, materials, electrical, and programming domains through collaborative, hands-on projects.

MANU 261.title: Thermodynamics
MANU 261.description: Thermodynamic system and properties, thermodynamic processes; work and heat interactions. Conservation of energy and First Law, internal energy and enthalpy, the Second Law and entropy, application to manufacturing processes.

MANU 265.title: Machine Dynamics
MANU 265.description: Classifications of mechanisms, velocity, acceleration and force analysis, graphical and computer-oriented vector and matrix methods, balancing, flywheels, gears, gear trains, cams.

MANU 270.title: Production Systems Management I
MANU 270.description: Impact of operations in increasing productivity and reducing waste. .

MANU 280.title: Manufacturing Engineering Laboratory
MANU 280.description: Theory, operational constraints, and problem solving in traditional manufacturing processes. Casting, heat treatment, bulk deformation (i.e. rolling, extrusion, drawing), machining, joining, and composites processing. Experiments in process and product characterization. .

MANU 330.title: Manufacturing Engineering Project I
MANU 330.description: Project-based, multi-step manufacturing engineering design and problem solving. .

MANU 370.title: Production Systems Management II
MANU 370.description: Functional area of production and operations management. Decision-making, capacity planning, aggregate planning, inventory management, distribution planning, materials requirements planning and quality control. .

MANU 378.title: Engineering Materials II
MANU 378.description: Materials selection for different design criteria; importance of shape and processing variables; computer software in selection. .

MANU 380.title: Manufacturing Processes I
MANU 380.description: Correlation between material properties and processibility for practical engineering manufacturing routes. Calculations and design. Application of heat/mass/fluid transport, mechanics and thermodynamics to manufacturing processes.
MANU 380.prerequisiteText: All of APSC_V 278, APSC_V 279, MTRL_V 264, MECH_V 260 and one of MECH_V 280, MTRL_V 263

MANU 386.title: Industrial Automation
MANU 386.description: Principle components of manufacturing automation, modelling of sensors-actuators and control systems, robotic programming, programmable logical control (PLC) systems and development of PLC ladder diagrams. .

MANU 430.title: Manufacturing Design Capstone Project
MANU 430.description: Project-based, multi-step, multi-part Capstone design project involving manufacturing engineering design methods, problem solving. .

MANU 450.title: Biomedical Manufacturing
MANU 450.description: Bulk and nanoscale manufacturing processes for biomedical devices, materials and therapeutics; drug delivery; host-tissue biomaterial interactions; surface modification of medical devices; sterilization techniques; good manufacturing processes; medical device regulation.

MANU 453.title: Additive Manufacturing Design
MANU 453.description: Design tools and methods for additive manufacturing, complex digital geometry creation, computer aided design tools, additive manufacturing workflow development, producibility analysis, analysis of 3D data sets for suitability to additive manufacturing processes. .

MANU 455.title: Factory Planning
MANU 455.description: Resources planning, layout and logistics. Modular production and cyber-physical manufacturing systems in laboratory scale, virtual manufacturing and factory automation. .

MANU 456.title: Manufacturing Information Systems
MANU 456.description: Data engineering and industrial IoT for smart manufacturing. Implementation of data pipelines, edge/cloud systems, and analytics to integrate factory operations with enterprise platforms.

MANU 457.title: Smart Manufacturing
MANU 457.description: Introduction to smart manufacturing systems and digital transformation strategies. Industry 4.0/5.0, IIoT architectures, smart factories, digital twins, cyber-physical systems, and cybersecurity.

MANU 458.title: Manufacturing for Clean Energy
MANU 458.description: Manufacturing and the net-zero energy transition; renewable, low-carbon and sustainable energy and electricity generation; energy, electricity transport, storage and batteries; hydrogen economy; carbon capture utilization and storage (CCUS). .

MANU 465.title: AI and Machine Learning Applications in Manufacturing
MANU 465.description: Artificial intelligence, machine learning techniques, Deep learning, Python libraries for machine learning, Basic signal processing techniques, Data Acquisition, Applications in Manufacturing, Use of sound to evaluate operation of CNC machinery, Use of AE sensor to evaluate metal 3D printing. .

MANU 480.title: Manufacturing Processes II
MANU 480.description: Numerical modelling of manufacturing processes, linkage between material, process, properties and product geometry, heat/mass transport, thermodynamics and design principles applied to practical engineering processes.

MANU 481.title: Manufacturing Processes III
MANU 481.description: Integrating concepts of primary (casting), secondary (deformation), and tertiary (machining and surface treatment) processes and economic and environmental assessment. .

MANU 485.title: Metal Cutting and Machine Tool Vibrations
MANU 485.description: Metal cutting and grinding mechanics; prediction of force-torque-power in turning, drilling, milling and grinding operations. Machine tool vibrations, forced and self-excited vibrations in machining, experimental modal testing of machine tools, chatter, and stability. .

MANU 487.title: Machine and Part Metrology
MANU 487.description: Laser interferometer measurement of volumetric accuracy; error mapping, modelling and compensation of errors, rotation metrology, spindle accuracy. Part dimension and surface metrology. Metrology instruments: coordinate measurement machine, surface profile meter, laser interferometer and ball bar. .
